primary_endpoint: reset momentum, both final canonical aligned weight matrices, C10, held-out seed-block balanced accuracy
conclusions: The paired 200-seed design identifies whether the two specified task-order labels can be decoded for new initialization seeds.
Each seed's two histories must remain together in every train, validation and test partition.

Permutation tests must independently swap the two labels within each seed block across all partitions and refit plus reselect the regularization parameter. Label-independent preprocessing may be cached.
The reference must be selected solely from training final weights without optimizing historical labels; final-test weights may only be aligned to that frozen reference.
Canonical equal-incoming/outgoing-norm gauge and one-hidden-layer Git Re-Basin assignment use the validated local metrics implementation.
Test block-bootstrap intervals condition on the already trained and selected probe, and do not include new training-split or reference-selection variability.
Perfect test decoding can produce a degenerate bootstrap interval; this is not a guarantee for the population of unseen networks.
Similar average final task accuracy does not establish equivalence. Report paired accuracy and loss differences, diagnostic-only probes and train-only covariate adjustment.
Holm correction should transparently cover the declared family of secondary horizon, layer, diagnostic, functional and momentum endpoints.
A functional-logit probe tests residual behavioral distinguishability on the fixed inputs, not the whole input distribution.
Negative-control accuracy need not equal 50 percent exactly in a finite sample; assess its interval and permutation calibration.
A positive weight-space endpoint establishes recoverable information about these two task orders; it does not identify all SGD updates or establish an attractor.

passed_source_checks: Training clones complete identical initial model state for both history arms.
Both history arms use the same precomputed seed-specific epoch-order arrays.
Reset condition creates a fresh SGD optimizer at both phase transitions; continued condition retains state.
Probe loading explicitly takes final W0/W1, diagnostics and logits only; initial weights and metadata cannot enter weight features.
Train-only canonical C10 weight-hash reference is frozen across horizons.
Scaling, diagnostic standardization, residualization and Gram projection use training indices only.
Exact linear train-Gram map is tested against original-feature L2 logistic regression.
Within-seed pair labels are swapped across all split blocks, followed by logistic refitting and validation selection.
Block-bootstrap indices retain both histories and all split indices are constructed in adjacent pairs.
Every aligned feature row is checked after hidden reindexing and positive gauge rescaling.
issues_reported: With 18 secondary endpoints and 199 permutations, minimum Holm-adjusted p=.09, making any secondary rejection impossible. Suggested raising secondary permutations before outcomes.
The frozen plan should explicitly exclude the random-label calibration endpoint from the confirmatory-secondary Holm family if the code does so.
implementation_review.issue_resolution: Both issues resolved by documented pre-analysis amendment: 999 secondary permutations and negative-control inclusion in the 19-endpoint Holm family.

important_limitations: Final C performance differs: approximately -0.81 percentage points for H1 minus H0; no equal-performance claim.
Raw logits decode the histories too; differences in softmax probabilities or predicted classes were not isolated.
Layer ablations use joint gauge and alignment; not independent raw-layer-only evidence.
Perfect held-out results yield degenerate conditional empirical bootstrap intervals; no population perfection guarantee.
